visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In an indoor entertainment hall with a green felt billiards table, a man in a white hoodie and black baseball cap prepares a shot. A woman in a white patterned long-sleeve top and black shorts bends forward with her hands on her knees, acting as a physical bridge for the pool cue. (2) The scene cuts to a second phase where the woman performs a deep backbend, arching her torso over the table. The man rests his cue stick on her arched stomach as he aims toward the balls. (3) The final phase depicts the woman in an advanced yoga-like stretch, holding one leg behind her head while standing. The man uses her body as a support for the cue stick to take a final shot, emphasizing extreme flexibility.
